player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma a ɛtrɛw {num_rounds} round.

Agyinamoa:
- Ansana woahyɛ biribiara no, wo wɔ {total_conversation_rounds} turns sɛ wo bɛtumi akasa pɛpɛɛpɛ.
- Akyiri yi, Player baanu no nyinaa bɛhyɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ biako anaa wɔbɛgyae.

Payoff Matrix (ɛyɛ koko da round):
- Player baanu no nyinaa yɛ biako ➜ obiara {cooperate_reward}
- Player baanu no nyinaa gyae ➜ obiara {mutual_defect_reward}
- Obi gyae, obi yɛ biako ➜ Gyani no {defect_reward}, Biako no {sucker_reward}

Sɛnea wo bɛyɛ:
- Bere a wokasa: to nkyerɛwee biara a wo pɛ.
- Bere a wohyɛ biribiara: fa '[Cooperate]' anaa '[Defect]' ka ho (ɛnsɛ sɛ wode karimaa). Wo betumi aka nkyerɛwee biara ansa/akyi token no.

phases.conversation_finished: Kasae no baa awiee wɔ round {round}. Mesrɛ wo sɛ wo bɛhyɛ '[Cooperate]' anaa '[Defect]' wɔ \boxed{{}} mu.

outcome.draw: Wɔbɔɔ agoru! Agorɔfoɔ mmienu no nyinaa bɔɔ {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Ná wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ adwuma bom.
outcome.round_both_defect: Agorɔfoɔ baanu no nyinaa tu fii wɔn mu.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Ɔpanyin 0 yɛɛ adwuma, na ɔpanin 1 guanee.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Ɔpanyin 0 na otuu kwan, ɔpanyin 1 yɛɛ adwuma.
